title: ABC 7 (Nabonidus Chronicle) — English translation on Livius.org
license: Translation after Grayson 1975 with revisions; paraphrased only

verification_log.method: Years 7, 9, 10, 11: "the king was in Tayma" while "the prince, his officers and army" were in Akkad and the Akitu festival was not held; year 17: Opis, Sippar taken on day 14, Ugbaru and Cyrus's army entered Babylon on day 16 without battle, Cyrus entered on 3 Arahsamna, Ugbaru died 11 Arahsamna
